closed_self_review_findings.consequence: Including false would incorrectly reject the real full response
closed_self_review_findings.correction: Independent derivation omits absent/false defer. All public fixture records lack defer.

closed_self_review_findings.condition: SDK call joins context.Canceled with notification failure
closed_self_review_findings.consequence: errors.Is alone would mask a second transport failure
closed_self_review_findings.correction: Only cancellation leaves are accepted; other error leaves fail and are retained in call/error evidence.

closed_self_review_findings.condition: A manual bounded close returns an error or unresolved ownership
closed_self_review_findings.consequence: Deferred fallback could launch a second wait for the same session
closed_self_review_findings.correction: Release controller session reference after its one explicit close attempt, before error return; no second close attempt in defer.

closed_self_review_findings.consequence: Unix timestamp subtraction is not a stable latency measurement
closed_self_review_findings.correction: Latencies use time.Time.Sub monotonic components; Unix values are correlation metadata only.

closed_self_review_findings.area: root independent finding: SDK close ordering
closed_self_review_findings.condition: Client cancellation retires outgoing call before server processResult has finished response processing; concurrent client.Close may close responsesR first
closed_self_review_findings.consequence: A late server write can encounter a reader closed by the profile itself; middleware settlement alone does not establish SDK session completion
closed_self_review_findings.correction: Graceful server.Close begins first, with client reader alive; only after its terminal result does client.Close begin. At the shared five-second deadline, close owned pipes and start any not-yet-started client.Close, then observe both for five more seconds. Each owner is started once.
closed_self_review_findings.primary_source: actual cached go-sdk@v1.6.1/internal/jsonrpc2/conn.go: updateInFlight/idle, Retire, Close/wait, handleAsync, processResult, write; all767 lines read through RDC
closed_self_review_findings.claim_limit: SDK write rejects when connClosing; Close exposes closeErr only. No assertion of delivery of already-retired late cancellation responses. Normal response completeness is checked at actual client before close.

oracles.derivation: Python JSON parsing independently checks all payload sequence numbers and exact 512-byte padding; no Go/CMake execution. All first8 record fields, all includes, all indexes and file ordering retained in oracle. Current native evidence.path is bound at runtime.

max_records=0 production default1000 projection with declared omissions8/1000/12/12
oracles.normal_measured: Every client response is exactly equal after JSON decode to the independent projected oracle, non-IsError, single TextContent, <=262144 bytes. Body SHA256 and byte count retained.
oracles.cancellation_measured: Require at least one client-only-cancellation result, one handler context.Canceled observation, and one handler unknown/canceled result. Completed-before-cancel responses must still pass normal response oracle. Full planned/submitted/received/completed/returned counts; handler errors, observation errors, duplicate/missing completion and unknown IDs fail.

memory_and_latency.scope: whole current process including driver, semantic verification, sampling, official SDK client and server; filesystem warmed by SHA admission and warmups
memory_and_latency.process_observer: current PID only; PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION; K32GetProcessMemoryInfo; exact96-byte x64 PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX2; strict validity checks; explicit CloseHandle result
snapshots: after GC retaining only actual client responses
after releasing responses+GC with session open
after sessions close and owned references released+GC
memory_and_latency.sampling: 5ms periodic samples plus baseline seed; per-field maxima are lower bounds and can occur at different times; not an exact continuous peak
memory_and_latency.retention_limit: Snapshot deltas include runtime/session/observer effects. No leak or production RSS bound follows from a single finite campaign.

lifecycle.observer_state: call map initialized before Connect; concurrent mutations and snapshots under mutex; full responses separate from report so release can be measured
lifecycle.worker_ownership: at most two workers, disjoint response slots, buffered completion channel; cancellation watcher joined per call; next call only after real handler completion
lifecycle.streams: only the four owned io.Pipe ends are closed, no stdin/stdout or foreign handles
lifecycle.closing: Server SDK Close first with live client reader; client Close starts after server terminal result. Combined graceful observation five seconds; on timeout close only owned pipe ends, start any pending client Close and observe both for another five seconds. Each owner starts once. Forced/unresolved close fails. Unsettled worker data is not cleared.
lifecycle.sampler: stop signal + completion channel; ticker stopped before completion is sent; process observer handle closes after sampler settled
lifecycle.limits: Context cannot forcibly interrupt an arbitrary blocked regular-file read or native memory query. Root retains outer test process handle/deadline. No whole-process guarantee from source review.
